RATIONALE: All eight fixed D10J communities must be analyzed and reported; no module may be omitted because its later biology is weak or uninteresting.
No reassignment, merging, splitting, pruning, or relabeling based on downstream biology.
Primary functional enrichment query for each community is every mRNA assigned to that community.
Custom universe is all 4,467 mRNA nodes in the frozen D10L network, not the whole human genome.
Homo sapiens.
Primary functional sources are Gene Ontology Biological Process and Reactome.
KEGG may be reported as a separately labeled secondary pathway source; it cannot determine module inclusion.
Use unordered overrepresentation analysis with a custom background.
Use g:Profiler significance_threshold_method=fdr and user_threshold=0.05.
Use custom statistical domain with the frozen 4,467-mRNA background.
No ranked/ordered enrichment in the primary analysis.
Do not exclude IEA annotations in the primary analysis; use g:Profiler default no_iea=False.
At execution, query and save g:Profiler data_versions for hsapiens before enrichment; all module queries must use the same observed service version.
COVID-vs-healthy significance is a disease annotation, not a filter for primary module enrichment.
|logFC|>=1 is secondary descriptive effect-size evidence only.
P-vs-H and COV-vs-P remain comparator evidence; they do not remove nodes from modules or enrichment.
Do not invent a binary COVID-specific label. Report three frozen evidence flags: COV-vs-H significance, P-vs-H significance, and COV-vs-P significance, plus directions.
A secondary miRNA-regulatory analysis may enrich only mRNA targets connected by the already frozen 1,978 regulatory-supported edges; no new target database expansion.
Use all mRNAs incident to any of the 1,978 frozen regulatory edges as the regulatory-target enrichment universe.
Positive/negative edge distributions characterize fixed modules but cannot alter modules or enrichment query membership.
Primary topological hub metric is within-community degree in the frozen 11,531-edge topology.
mRNA and miRNA hubs are ranked separately within each community to respect the bipartite topology.
Primary hub candidates are nodes at or above the 90th percentile of internal degree within the same community and node type; ties are retained.
Regulatory hub evidence is reported separately using only the frozen regulatory-supported edges.
A hub can be annotated as COVID-associated when COV-vs-H FDR<=0.05; this does not change hub status.
No post-hoc weighted composite score mixing degree, DE, regulation, enrichment, or sign evidence.
All modules are reported. No post-hoc module score is used to suppress modules.
Narrative emphasis may note modules showing concordant functional enrichment, regulatory support, and COVID DE evidence, but all underlying module results remain reported.
Functional enrichment is post-hoc biological characterization and must not be presented as independent validation of A-CLA.
RUN_COUNT=1 was prospectively frozen; do not claim multi-seed or perturbation stability for these communities.
Topology-derived hubs are candidates/descriptive priorities, not validated biomarkers.
Interpretation may generate biological hypotheses but not causal or clinical claims.
